reate a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a task ag
ainst one or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate` — that route
persists nothing.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/index.txt:277:- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-s
ecrets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA ONLY — no value is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared
secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; another member's personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.\n/worksp
ace/mcpjam-eval/docs/index.txt:278:- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a
credential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the c
all. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin; a personal one does not.\n/workspace/
mcpjam-eval/docs/index.txt:279:- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metad
ata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another project —
and another member's personal secret — both read as 404.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/index.txt:280:- [Delete a secret](https://do

o, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked cr
edential undeletable until someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must never wa…\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/in
dex.txt:281:- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate th
e value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already running holds the old value — mater
ialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back — and there is no safe way to replace it mid

83:- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists

ng`.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/index.txt:284:- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journ

ocs/index.txt:286:- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a du
rable Stop request and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in the background; status rem
ains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `

ect-wide trend. Deterministic and free — start here.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/index.txt:288:- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](h

renceCount` and `status` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/

om your view. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that fires

- [Get swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-swarm-run-insights.md): Poll this after reques
ting insights. **404 means nobody asked** — it is deliberately not an empty `status: \"none\"` body, so a caller in a polling loop

un insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/request-swarm-run-insights.md): Answers **202**: generation is s
